_about: The models the desktop apps carry inside them: Velox (fast) and Scriba (it thinks) of Ingenium's lineup, listed in ingenium.html (ING_LINEUP), which also installs the stronger ones (Magister, Faber) in the app. 'desktop' is the Windows and Intel Mac apps, 'mac-arm' the Mac app for Apple silicon (a Mac mini, for example). The build downloads each from Hugging Face and refuses it unless its SHA-256 matches; tools/check_lineup.py checks this file against the page. Set a platform (or 'models') to null to build without built-in models. One file on a GitHub release may be at most 2 GB, so one app's models must stay well under that together.
